data.one_liner: Dynamically change the app launcher icon on Android and iOS at runtime.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that lets applications switch their launcher icon dynamically on both Android and iOS. It provides an API to change, reset, and check the currently active app icon.
use_when: You want to let users customize their app launcher icon from within the app settings.
Your app has seasonal, achievement-based, or user-selectable icon themes.
avoid_when: You only need to generate static icons at build-time rather than changing them dynamically at runtime.
You require hidden or automatic icon changes on iOS using unsupported private APIs.
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS out of the box.
Provides clear handling of platform-specific behaviors like Android's deferred background icon application.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration including Android activity-aliases and iOS asset catalogs.
iOS icon changes trigger a native system confirmation alert.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding alternate icons to Android mipmap folders and updating AndroidManifest.xml with activity-aliases, as well as setting up alternate app icon sets in Xcode for iOS.

alternatives.name: flutter_launcher_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick flutter_launcher_icons if you only need to configure static launcher icons at build-time rather than changing them dynamically at runtime.
